label: Marinesia AIS Vessels → TAK
info:
Boats and ships on Tennessee rivers and lakes from AIS, with MIL-STD-2525 vessel symbols by type (tug, towing, pleasure craft, fishing, passenger and more), flag, destination and navigation status.

Data: Marinesia AIS API (https://marinesia.com/). Updates every 30 seconds.

Needs: Your own [Marinesia](https://marinesia.com/) API key (a free trial key allows 5 requests a minute).

Setup:
1. Double-click TAK Server :8089, set your TAK Server address, then edit its TLS config and upload your client certificate and key.
2. Set MARINESIA_API_KEY in the tab's Environment Variables (keep the type as *credential*). Don't share your key.
3. Click Deploy.

Full instructions: https://github.com/SECT0101/NodeRED-TAK/tree/main/flows/ais-marinesia
